mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{beginUtc} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{beginUtc} AND status IN ('in_service', 'completed') THEN lawyer_income_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_income_cents, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('in_service', 'completed') THEN lawyer_income_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_income_cents, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_accept_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'in_service' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_service_count FROM orders WHERE lawyer_id = #{lawyerId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT o.* FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.lawyer_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(o.lawyer_income_cents, 0) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM balance_flow f WHERE f.owner_type = 'lawyer' AND f.biz_type = 'income' AND f.biz_id = o.id ) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.amount_cents), 0) AS income_cents, COALESCE(SUM(o.platform_fee_cents), 0) AS fee_cents FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.lawyer_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(o.lawyer_income_cents, 0) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM balance_flow f WHERE f.owner_type = 'lawyer' AND f.biz_type = 'income' AND f.biz_id = o.id )
SELECT DISTINCT lawyer_id FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND lawyer_id IS NOT NULL AND finished_at >= #{beginUtc} AND finished_at < #{endUtc} ORDER BY lawyer_id
